dataExport.title: Your data
dataExport.description: Download a copy of the information CircleCare stores about you as a JSON file.
dataExport.success: Your data export has been downloaded.
dataExport.rateLimited: You have reached today's export limit. Please try again tomorrow.
dataExport.error: We couldn't prepare your export. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and every care circle you own. This cannot be undone. Want a copy of your information first? Use 'Download my data' above.
delete.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and every care circle you own — including all medications, appointments, tasks, notes, vitals, documents and emergency information in them. Everyone else in those circles loses access, and they will be notified. Circles you belong to but do not own are not deleted; you are simply removed from them. This cannot be undone.
delete.error: We couldn't delete your account. Your account is unchanged — please try again, or email support@circlecare.app.

analytics.description: Control what usage data you share with us.
analytics.hint: Linked to your account, including your email address. Helps us improve CircleCare — never includes your readings, medication names, or message content.
